findings.highlight: ...I've more or less gotten used to how the pain works.
findings.evidenceJa: ……痛みの仕組みがどんなモノなのかはだいたい呑み込めた。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks he has more or less grasped how the pain works, then explains his cooling/heat-transfer model.
findings.explanation: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.

findings.highlight: Every time the red vertigo comes, I feel a long blade stab me in the shoulder, and I almost think I hear grinding sounds inside my body.
findings.evidenceJa: この赤い目眩が起きるたび、肩から長い刃物を突き刺され、体ん中をギチギチとかき回される錯覚がする。
findings.governingReading: During red vertigo Shirou feels as though a long blade enters at the shoulder and grinds/stirs violently around inside his body.
findings.explanation: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.

findings.highlight: Until Shirou repays that debt, he has to do what I say. If I order him to surrender his home or cook me three meals a day, he'll gladly comply, won't he?"
findings.evidenceJa: その借りを返すまで、士郎はわたしの言うコトを聞くしかないの。居場所を明け渡せって言えば明け渡してくれるし、ちゃんと三食付きにしてって言ったらしてくれるのよねぇ？」
findings.governingReading: Rin jokes that until the debt is repaid Shirou must obey, including giving up space for her and providing three meals.
findings.explanation: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.
